Agentic AI: A Complete Framework

Five nested circles, from AI & machine learning at the core, through deep learning, generative AI and AI agents, to agentic AI that automates whole processes. Each sticky note is one capability. Press ▶ to watch the circles grow, pick a circle to light up its notes, or tap any note.

Tap a note

Each note explains one capability in a sentence and links to where this site covers it.

Notes and circles follow the original figure; spelling slips in it are corrected (for example “Hallucination”, “Orchestration”, “Context Management”, “Audio/Music”), and the explanations are ours. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site.
